{"ascii":"[M] Isolated Change Proposals
|-- Review boundary: ChangeSessionService
|   |-- Exposes capture/create, proposal reads, edits/history, readiness and acceptance
|   |-- Keeps serialization, controller reconstruction and change detection internal
|   `-- Depends on repository context, proposal storage, live-canvas bridge and catalog publication
|-- [D] Frozen evidence -> proposal baseline
|   |-- Repository selection -> pinned repositoryId, commits, head and optional comparisonBase
|   |   `-- Capture Git hunks once; retain patches and identities with the proposal
|   |-- Settled catalog canvases + selected live workspace snapshots
|   |   |-- Filter by repository; live snapshots replace matching catalog baselines
|   |   |-- Multiple live workspaces require an explicit canvasId
|   |   `-- Retain savedRevisionId and captured live state for later conflict checks
|   |-- Existing proposal as capture source
|   |   `-- Reuse its original baselines and pinned hunks; fork fresh histories
|   `-- [O] create() clones captured documents into a draft
|       |-- Each document retains baseline, proposed state, version and independent history
|       |-- New proposal documents have no baseline
|       `-- Project + requestId determine proposal identity; signature detects conflicting reuse
|-- [C] Proposal edits -> MappingDocumentController -> saved proposal
|   |-- applyUpdate(expected document version, operations)
|   |   `-- Record proposed state, node origins, version and exported history
|   |-- undo / redo / reset -> same controller and history machinery
|   |   `-- Reset requires an original baseline; history changes return status to draft
|   |-- [D] Baseline + proposed state -> generated change records
|   |   |-- Detect subtree-variant changes, diagram changes and incident-edge changes
|   |   |-- A document without a baseline contributes a new-canvas change
|   |   `-- Preserve matching annotations and dependsOn links when regenerating changes
|   `-- [O] Service serializes mutations per proposal
|       |-- Matching request receipt -> replay saved result before checking stale versions
|       |-- Changed signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|       `-- Accepted or archived proposals reject edits
|-- [D] DiffTree connects review structure to captured evidence
|   |-- Stored tree revision + stable node identities + mappings + captured hunks
|   |-- Default tree groups hunks by commit; custom tree can replace that organization
|   |-- Mapping source is an explicit tree line or node ID
|   |   `-- Targets are hunk IDs and/or diagram destinations
|   |-- Tree edits require the expected revision and replace mappings together with the tree
|   |   `-- Validate node identities, hunk identities, mapping targets and pinned Git context
|   `-- Selected nodes + mappings -> deduplicated hunk IDs and unmapped-node IDs
|-- [C] Automated entry -> DiffSessionWorkflowService
|   |-- Direct start or PushIntegrationService.receive()
|   |   |-- Push identity = connection + eventId; duplicate delivery shares/reuses generation
|   |   |-- Skip non-branch refs, deletions, unchanged refs and pushes without net changes
|   |   `-- Resolved push -> start(repository, commits, head=after, comparisonBase=before)
|   |-- Capture -> save context/prompts -> open agent session
|   |   `-- Requires pinned context and at least one captured hunk
|   |-- analyze -> materialize -> validate
|   |   |-- [M] DiffSessionTools enforces stage and target boundaries
|   |   |   |-- Analyze: frozen baseline search, captured hunks, source reader and API discovery
|   |   |   |-- Materialize: create this run's proposal from the same frozen capture
|   |   |   |   `-- Bind editing/search tools to that proposal; reject another proposal ID
|   |   |   `-- Complete: require ready status, changes and coverage of every captured hunk
|   |   `-- Final validation requires this run's own ready proposal -> completed, ready for review
|   `-- [O] Workflow retains abort controller, run state, transcript, artifacts and metrics
|       |-- Failure/cancellation -> failed/cancelled run; inactive running record -> interrupted
|       `-- Finally save artifacts, dispose agent session and save run; release active/live entries
|-- [C] Explicit acceptance -> catalog publication
|   |-- Require expected proposal version and ready status
|   |-- validateReady()
|   |   |-- Require changes; validate DiffTree, repository ownership and migrations
|   |   |-- Every dependsOn target must exist; reject dependency cycles
|   |   `-- Validate edge anchors; added diagrams need an incoming edge from a baseline diagram
|   |-- [D] Generated changes -> affected documents only
|   |   |-- Matching live documents + captured baselines -> compare document state and name
|   |   |   `-- Divergence -> VERSION_CONFLICT; create a new proposal
|   |   `-- Proposed documents + exported histories + savedRevisionId -> acceptCanvasChanges()
|   |       `-- Pass savedRevisionId as expectedRevisionId for the published-baseline check
|   `-- [O] Catalog acceptance receipt -> finishAcceptance() -> persist accepted status
|       |-- Receipt records proposal version, request, changes and before/after checkpoints
|       |-- Same acceptance request/version -> return accepted summary
|       |-- Different acceptance request/version -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|       `-- Publication succeeds but proposal write fails -> catalog receipt is authoritative
|           `-- Reads project accepted status; get()/accept() repair the full proposal record
`-- [M] Durable proposal storage: ChangeSessionRecords
    |-- Exposes summaries, previews, DiffTree reads, full reads and incremental writes
    |-- [O] Manifest retains references to immutable document, receipt and DiffTree records
    |   |-- Documents split into metadata, baseline, proposed state and history checkpoints
    |   `-- DiagramPersistence externalizes/restores diagram data through shared revision storage
    |-- [C] Write -> serialize by manifest -> check supplied expected token
    |   `-- Validate and store changed records -> retain unchanged references -> publish manifest
    `-- [D] Read scope determines required records
        |-- Summary -> manifest metadata
        |-- Preview -> one document's baseline/proposed state; omit history and replay receipts
        |-- Full read -> documents, histories, receipts and DiffTree; return manifest token
        `-- Treemaps -> captured DiffTree + document previews from one proposal version
            `-- Version changes during loading -> VERSION_CONFLICT; retry"}
